adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
adds.text: Back in New York, Karen helps Matt dig through Foggy's old case files and uncovers Fisk's plan to turn Red Hook into a free port beyond the city's law.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor whose Red Hook free-port scheme Karen uncovers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The woman who uncovers Fisk's Red Hook scheme in Foggy's files.
adds.evidence: Straight to Hell (Born Again 1x09): Karen returns after Dex's escape, notes Fisk went after Murdock, and with Matt finds Foggy's files showing Red Hook is a free port the Fisks want as their own city-state; she then scouts Red Hook with Matt and warns him Fisk has all the power. They share no scene, so this is investigative enmity like her DD S3#3 stage.
